title: Karbobala me zainabe muztar ne di sada
body:
KARBOBALA MEIN ZAIBAN-E-MUZTAR NE DI SADA
MAARA GAYA HAI NAHER PE SAQQA-E-KARBALA
Ek dopaher mein lut gaya gulzare panjetan
Bikhre huwe hain lashe shahedon ke bekafan
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar hain kahin pe aur pade hai kahin badan
Hai dard-o-gham ki dasht me chaye huwe ghata
Tum jo nahi to bali Sakina hai beqarar
Soojhe huwe hain gaal to kurta hai taar taar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti hai aa bhi jao chacha roke baar baar
Shumr-e-layee’n ki uspa har ek gaam hai jafa
Tum the to Ahl-e-Baite Nabi ko tha itmenan
Hai besahara aaj Mohammed ka khandaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalim hamare sabr ka lete hai imtehaan
Lut-te hain ab qayam chhini jati hai rida
Qaidi banayi jati hai Aulaad-e-Mustafa
Jakda huwa hai tauq mein beemar-e-Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab karwan-e-Haq ka nahi koi aasraa
Uttho madad ko aao Alamdar-e-Bawafa
Saidaniyo ke lab pa hai paiham yahi fughaa’n
Is bekasi mein jayen to jayenge hum kahaa’n
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaane kataye sota hai hum sab ka pasbaa’n
Tanhaeyaa’n hai zulm-o-sitam ki hai inteha
Beemar-e-Karbala pe qayamat ki hai ghadi
Gardan mein tauq pau’n mein zanjeer aahani
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo hathkadi wo aable shiddat wo dhoop ki
Tye hoga kaise dard-o-musibat ka raasta
Kehti hai roke bali Sakina mere chacha
Aakhir sabab ye aane mein takheer ka hai kya
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap aayenge to dil ko mere chain aayega
Hargiz karoongi ab na mai pani ki ilteja
Mashk-o-Alam to laye Shahensha-e-Karbala
Lasha jari ka sahil-e-dariya pa reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaimo mein Aye Sohail Qayamat huwe bapa
Kehti thi jab Sakina kahan hai mera chacha
